component.summary: Browse and organize files and folders
फ़ाइलें और फ़ोल्डर देखें और व्यवस्थित करें

description.p: Files provides a clear native view of local folders, file details, and common organization actions.
It is designed for keyboard and pointer workflows while preserving Linux filesystem behavior and permissions.
